description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Ice], [Awoken Monk], [Damage Cap +10000], [Physical Blink 3] and [Righteous Fist Mode] to the user

description.name: Attach Ice
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Ice damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Ice resistance +20%

description.name: Awoken Monk
description.text: Monk abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Monk abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Physical Blink 3
description.text: Evades the next 3 PHY attacks that deal physical, missing HP or fixed damage or NAT attacks that deal physical or fractional damage

description.name: Righteous Fist Mode
description.text: Critical chance =100%, cast speed x2.00, casts Ice Cluster after using three Monk abilities, removed if user hasn't any Physical Blink
